mapper.select: SELECT id FROM member WHERE id = #{memberId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE

SELECT m.birth_date, cs.first_goal_type, cs.target_period_months FROM member m INNER JOIN common_survey cs ON cs.id = COALESCE( ( SELECT ic.common_survey_id FROM couple c INNER JOIN invitation_code ic ON ic.id = c.invitation_code_id WHERE c.inviter_id = m.id OR c.invitee_id = m.id ), ( SELECT own_cs.id FROM common_survey own_cs WHERE own_cs.member_id = m.id ) ) WHERE m.id = #{memberId} AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND m.deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO personal_survey ( member_id, annual_income, monthly_available_amount, financial_asset_ratio, financial_knowledge, capital_preservation_attitude ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{annualIncome}, #{monthlyAvailableAmount}, #{financialAssetRatio}, #{financialKnowledge}, #{capitalPreservationAttitude} )
mapper.update: UPDATE personal_survey SET annual_income = #{annualIncome}, monthly_available_amount = #{monthlyAvailableAmount}, financial_asset_ratio = #{financialAssetRatio}, financial_knowledge = #{financialKnowledge}, capital_preservation_attitude = #{capitalPreservationAttitude}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND member_id = #{memberId}

mapper.select: SELECT c.id AS couple_id, inviter.investment_type AS inviter_investment_type, invitee.investment_type AS invitee_investment_type FROM couple c INNER JOIN member inviter ON inviter.id = c.inviter_id INNER JOIN member invitee ON invitee.id = c.invitee_id WHERE (c.inviter_id = #{memberId} OR c.invitee_id = #{memberId}) AND inviter.investment_type IS NOT NULL AND invitee.investment_type IS NOT NULL
